mapper.sql: t.id, t.code, t.name, t.description, t.dormant_after_months, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.account a WHERE a.account_type_id = t.id) AS account_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app.account_type t ORDER BY t.code
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.account_type WHERE code = #{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.account_type (code, name, description, dormant_after_months) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dormantAfterMonths})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.account_type SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dormant_after_months = #{dormantAfterMonths}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
